title.it: Il controllo per i nuovi pazienti

setting.sl: Pravkar si {m:izbral|f:izbrala} splošno ambulanto v Keswicku. Preden greš k zdravniku, medicinska sestra nove paciente vpraša o zdravju: o boleznih in operacijah, alergijah, zdravilih, zdravju v družini in vsakdanjih navadah. Izmeri ti tudi krvni pritisk.
setting.de: Du hast dich gerade bei der Hausarztpraxis in Keswick angemeldet. Bevor du zum Arzt gehst, fragt die Krankenschwester neue Patienten nach ihrer Gesundheit: Krankheiten und Operationen, Allergien, Medikamente, die Gesundheit der Familie und die Gewohnheiten im Alltag. Sie misst auch deinen Blutdruck.
setting.it: Ti sei appena {m:iscritto|f:iscritta} all'ambulatorio del medico di base a Keswick. Prima della visita, l'infermiera fa ai nuovi pazienti alcune domande sulla salute: malattie e operazioni, allergie, farmaci, la salute della famiglia e le abitudini di tutti i giorni. Ti misura anche la pressione.
setting.en: You have just registered with the GP surgery in Keswick. Before you see a doctor, the practice nurse asks new patients about their health: illnesses and operations, allergies, medicines, the family's health and everyday habits. She takes your blood pressure too.

role: Nurse Pattinson, the practice nurse at the surgery in Keswick, doing a new patient check. Calm, methodical, kind: past illnesses and operations, allergies, medicines, family history, smoking, drinking (units a week), exercise. One question at a time; asks for details and checks she has understood.
speaker: young-woman

goals.en: Tell her about illnesses and operations you've had
goals.sl: Povej ji o boleznih in operacijah, ki si jih {m:imel|f:imela}
goals.de: Erzähl ihr von Krankheiten und Operationen, die du hattest
goals.it: Raccontale delle malattie e delle operazioni che hai avuto

goals.en: Say what you're allergic to and what you take
goals.sl: Povej, na kaj si {m:alergičen|f:alergična} in katera zdravila jemlješ
goals.de: Sag, wogegen du allergisch bist und was du nimmst
goals.it: Di' a che cosa sei {m:allergico|f:allergica} e che farmaci prendi

goals.en: Answer her questions about your family's health
goals.sl: Odgovori na vprašanja o zdravju v družini
goals.de: Beantworte ihre Fragen zur Gesundheit deiner Familie
goals.it: Rispondi alle domande sulla salute della tua famiglia
Descrivi con sincerità le tue abitudini

opener_sl: Hello, come in and have a seat. As you're new to the practice, I'd like to ask you a few questions about your health first. Is that all right?

opener_en.sl: Dober dan, naprej in kar sedite. Ker ste pri nas novi, bi vam najprej rada zastavila nekaj vprašanj o zdravju. Je to v redu?
opener_en.de: Hallo, kommen Sie herein und setzen Sie sich. Da Sie neu in der Praxis sind, möchte ich Ihnen zuerst ein paar Fragen zu Ihrer Gesundheit stellen. Passt das?
opener_en.it: Buongiorno, entri e si sieda. Visto che è {m:nuovo|f:nuova} da noi, vorrei prima farle qualche domanda sulla sua salute. Va bene?
opener_en.en: Hello, come in and sit down. Since you're new here, I'd like to ask you some questions about your health first. Is that OK?
